senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. preced. a. נָכָה Hif.) to strike, smash, esp. (cmp. נָגַע a. כְּתַשׁ) to strike with leprosy.
units: Yalk. Is. 271 כמו שצָרַעְתִּי את ידך as I struck thy (Moses’) hand with leprosy.—Part. pass. צָרוּעַ leper.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:5">Num. R. s. 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01943"><he>פָּרַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> he who encourages strife <he>ראוי לִיצְטָרֵעַ</he> deserves to be stricken with leprosy.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 107a">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>ששה חדשים נ׳ דוד</he> David was a leper for six months.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:13">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> <he>לא נִצְטָרְעָה היד וכ׳</he> Moses’ hand did not become leprous, until he had taken it out &c.; a. e.
